notes.title: First Anniversary + Lost in Cult Art Book
notes.content:
Friends of the Sarcophagus, today marks the first anniversary since the cycle began and we’ve hit an incredible milestone, 100,000 delivered! Thank you so much to our wonderful community, you are all part of the colourful light.🌱✨

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156092/cce810e09c538ca2438431a08146d673294b43b9.jpg


ULTROS Artbook with Lost in Cult

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156092/37dddccd39f9a38d01106fc55563115e5a948985.gif

Fans looking to delve deeper into the world of ULTROS can now pre-order Ultros: Design Works, created in collaboration with Lost in Cult. This high-end art book features never-before-seen artwork, concept sketches, in-depth essays, exclusive developer interviews and much more!

A Deluxe Edition is also available, including a CD containing creator podcasts, 12 art cards, posters, stickers, and more. Early birds looking to pre-order the Deluxe Edition in the first 48 hours will receive a slight discount. Plus, the first 300 copies sold of the campaign-exclusive Deluxe Edition will include a signed bookplate. 

To pre-order and learn more about the Ultros: Design Works Standard and Deluxe Editions, head on over to Lost in Cult.

notes.title: 🌱 Help ULTROS Bloom! 🌱
notes.content:
Hey there, seedlings! 

We’ve pushed some exciting updates in an open test branch, and we need your help to make sure they sprout just right. Dig in, explore the latest improvements, and let us know if anything needs a little extra pruning! 🌸

What’s New in This Version?

 Room to Grow: Faster load times and a dramatic reduction in installed storage size (7GB → 3GB).
 Map Enhancements: More clarity to help you navigate the game!
 Gameplay Tweaks: New perks, ability adjustments, and smoother scenarios to cultivate your skills.
 Bug Fixes: We’ve weeded out a ton of pesky issues to keep your gameplay flourishing.

See the full patch notes below for the full scoop of what's included in this update!



How to Participate
1️⃣ Plant Yourself in the Test Branch: Go to ULTROS in your game library - right click and select "Properties...", then "Betas".
2️⃣ Opt into opentest, selectable in the drop down menu.
📝 Share your findings through this form: https://www.ultrosgame.com/support



When?
The Test Branch is live now! Don’t leaf us hanging—jump in and help shape the future of the game.


Full update notes
We've completely overhauled how assets are loaded in the game. This has resulted in faster load times for some players and a significant reduction in the installed storage size, shrinking from 7 GB to 3 GB. These changes have impacted how Rooms load and how fade-in and fade-out transitions function. If you encounter any issues related to these areas, we’d greatly appreciate your feedback!

Extractor Changes

The Remote Trimmer can now cut through breakable rocks
You can now destroy the contents of the Splicer by firing at the ground (hold for 1.5 seconds)
The Digger can now grab things (seeds, compost, nests) without boosting
Increased speed of upgraded Thruster

Map Changes

Seeds and item chests appear on map
Breakable blocks animate slightly on the map, making them easier to see
The “Track Gardens” perk now displays unused planting patches on the map
Dark zones will now be permanently lit up on the map once they have been explored, instead of reverting when the game is reloaded (this does not change existing save files, zones need to be lit up again after applying this patch for the effect to become permanent)
Filtering option on map (connection, icons, plants)
Fixed long straight connection lines that could sometimes appear on world map

Ability Changes

Intake perks now drain their respective nutrients 
Rebalanced the HWK Intake so Ouji is never completely immune to detection, but the range still varies by intake level
Enabled aerial item throw while unarmed
Scenario Changes

If you end up stuck without a sword, Gärdner can now bail you out if you visit the east end of his garden
Added shortcuts to make many of the ball puzzles in Infinity Lake optional
Added 2 planting patches in Pantheon of the Stars and Infinity Lake to ease connecting in frustrating spots, and provide better introductions to Wildling and Devadaru seeds
Some doors will now open to Ouji if she is not carrying a sword, allowing her to escape getting stuck in combat scenarios
Gärdner now immediately feedbacks on digging tunnels for the Uloborus in the Garden
If the Qualia chase is somehow bypassed, it can now be triggered by Gärdner’s first Ogu Mumin
Pantheon games will no longer activate after the Host is defeated in that cycle


Thank you for nurturing ULTROS with your care and feedback. Together, we’ll make it thrive! 🌳✨

notes.title: Maintenance on the Sarcophagus
notes.content:
GAMEPLAY CHANGES


 Once you unlock the True Returner, you will now keep your item inventory across cycles
 Ouji runs 50% faster in water
 Ouji no longer gets pushed along by minor water flows
 Sprayer has more generous range and more immediate effect
 Sprayer now travels faster when controlled with a game pad (on par with mouse controls).
 It is now much easier to plant seeds in walls by performing an aerial item throw while right next to the gardening spot
 Knockback force and angle of Air Tesseract double-kick has been reworked to make it much more useful for juggling items in Infinity Lake and elsewhere
 Knockback of Drop Kick is similarly adjusted to put it more in line with the default aerial attack
 Various animation and attack tweaks for the fight against Vasa
 Ouji now retains her running speed across room transitions
 Roots now bend the other way when they regrow after a cut, giving advanced gardeners some limited control over their shape


CLARITY


 Added an unskippable tutorial popup when Gärdner explains how to create new gardening spots
 Added text descriptions for seeds and extractor tools in their selection wheels
 More visible cloud of dark wisps surrounding newly acquired extractor tools, and clearer visual effect when they nullify a dark barrier
 Brunzon now explicitly asks for a demonstration of the Sprayer


INPUT 

 Input rebinding is now available in the pause menu, in addition to the title menu
 Controls can be freely rebound to mouse buttons
 Controller input can now be rebound
 Added custom cursor
 Cursor now becomes hidden when using a gamepad


OPTIONS


 Added the option to control extractor tools with the same inputs as controlling Ouji, allowing play without the right stick (or without mouse). Some tools work a little differently with this option enabled, especially when playing on keyboard.
 Added an "energy bar" in the Graphics menu to give a ballpark idea of how various options affect energy consumption


BUGFIXES


 Fixed a bug where glitched flower connections could cause the game to freeze when leaving an area or entering a save station
 Fixed various bugs and inconsistencies in the chase sequence
 Fixed a bug where mechanical walls could respawn if the game was reloaded after removing any plants that obstruct the wall (please note that they will still respawn this way if a cycle passes)
 Fixed a bug where dropping items inside a shaman's chamber would leave Ouji unable to use items
 Added missing French font character "œ"
 Additional bugfixes

notes.title: Repairs have been made on the Sarcophagus✨🪐
notes.content:
The following fixes have been rolled out in Ultros:


Adjusted the physics for flying with the Thruster extractor, for a much smoother ride
Added a 4K resolution option. PLEASE NOTE that this only affects some of the graphics (in particular the UI) because the artwork was created with an HD resolution in mind (1920 x 1080, or "Sharp" in the options menu). 4K will still cause your computer to use roughly twice the electricity compared to playing in HD, so we only recommend the setting if you are playing on a very large screen. Therefore, "Sharp" remains the default setting.
Removed a limitation on how far plants can grow immediately after replacing another plant.
Adjusted level design in Infinity Lake with new tools for players who may have gotten stuck, including a new planting patch and a few mushrooms for charging the Thruster
Fixed a crash that could happen when growing Augeas plants through an area transition and then returning later
Fixed a bug where music and audio could get stuck in a dampened state permanently.
Fixed a hang that could happen when breaking open a shaman pod while also carrying connection wisps
Improved registering for achievements "The pound of flesh which I demand" and "The feast of harvest"
Fixed other minor bugs



🌱 Relish the reparations 🌱
